visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a scenic shot of a blue sky and white clouds. A green 7-Eleven sign stands tall next to a parking lot and a coastline. Yellow text overlays provide location and pricing details. (2) The scene shifts to a wooded campsite with tall, thin trees. A man wearing a black baseball cap and a dark t-shirt is seen from the waist up, gesturing as he talks to an unseen person. The sunlight filters through the tree branches. (3) A young woman appears, wearing a white zip-up jacket, denim jeans, a dark baseball cap, and sunglasses. She walks across a gravel-paved area while carrying a white plastic garbage bag. Cars and trailers are parked in the background under more trees. (4) Drone/aerial footage provides a high-angle view of the campsite stretched along the beach. Several white tents and campers are visible next to the blue ocean waves crashing on the shore. (5) The camera captures functional areas: a row of outdoor stainless steel sinks set against a light blue wall, and a series of large cylindrical 'water pipe' cabins and triangular wooden huts with tables and chairs set outside. (6) The woman is shown again in the campsite, walking toward large black trash bins located next to colorful painted walls and green bushes. (7) The video concludes with wide shots of a circular concrete plaza near the beach, featuring decorative structures and a path leading directly to the ocean under a clear sky.
